members.name: Shift Crew
members.why: Vanilla 4 for 4 with no ability; nothing purple about it.

members.name: Recruiter
members.why: 5 red for +1 red per recruit is a forgettable trickle that rarely pays back.

members.name: Customs Officer
members.why: A small consolation when you're robbed; 6 cost for +1 yellow is dead.

members.name: Tastemaker
members.why: Few cards change rivals' resources, so it rarely fires.

members.name: Regular
members.why: +1 blue when you buy followers; nobody notices.

members.name: Timekeeper
members.why: Generic per-own-color scorer, a sibling of Chronicler and Snobs.

members.name: Dyer
members.why: Same per-color shape as Tourist and Caravan but paying yellow; autopilot.

members.name: Critic
members.why: +1 follower when rivals buy blue; small, passive.

members.name: Heiresses
members.why: 9 cost for a one-time per-member white pile; weak and leader-friendly.

members.name: Old Money
members.why: Generic per-own-color scorer, a sibling of Chronicler, Snobs and Timekeeper.

members.name: Volunteer
members.why: Vanilla 1-for-1 body; only matters as red count or swap fodder.

members.name: Toastmaster
members.why: +1 follower for taking your own color's spaces; generic trickle.

members.name: Patriarch
members.why: Generic game-end per-member scorer that would sit the same in any color.

members.name: Polisher
members.why: A one-shot Polish on a card; repeats a sibling.

members.name: Snobs
members.why: Per-own-color game-end scorer; same shape as three others.

members.name: Chronicler
members.why: Per-own-color game-end scorer; same shape as three others.

members.name: Extra Hand
members.why: 9 cost for one extra minion once; rarely worth it.

members.name: Caterer
members.why: +1 silver on gifts, unclear per gift or per silver; forgettable.

members.name: Landlord
members.why: Steady +2 white; works the same in any cult.

members.name: Roadie
members.why: Scales with green members, pure self-engine, nobody else notices.

members.name: Alchemists
members.why: Cheap 3-count that makes every cost easy; nobody notices.

members.name: Night Watch
members.why: Passive payout on rivals taking the token; unclear whose minions count and no choice for the owner.

members.name: Caravan
members.why: Strong per-color income but a third copy of the Dyer/Tourist shape.

members.name: Proselytizers
members.why: +1 follower per recruit; steady and private, rewards the wide leader.

members.name: Harmonist
members.why: Game-end full sets scorer; on theme but quiet and leader-friendly.

members.name: Busker
members.why: Steady +2 green; works the same in any cult.

members.name: Philanthropist
members.why: A small Largesse on a member; repeats the space.

members.name: Grifter
members.why: Scales with your cult size, so it rewards the leader.

members.name: Line Cutters
members.why: Worth 3 for 2 and overrides fewest-followers-first, so the leader keeps first pick: must-buy and anti-catch-up.

members.name: Greeters
members.why: Cheap 2-count that adds color to every On Recruit across colors; invisible to rivals.

members.name: Brokers
members.why: A bonus on white follower spaces; unclear on copies, quiet.

members.name: Impressionist
members.why: +1 resource when anyone copies: a small trigger nobody feels.

members.name: Dabblers
members.why: Wild double member is a neat connector for color counts, but 'wild' needs a ruling on what it counts for.

members.name: High Society
members.why: Taxes rivals using silver spaces; a passive deterrent with no choice for the owner.

members.name: Window Dressers
members.why: A cheap 3-body with a small shop shuffle; repeats Window Shopper.

members.name: Extortionist
members.why: A bigger Cutpurse; repeats its sibling.

members.name: Con Men
members.why: Big one-shot steal of 5; simple and felt, but it's just a bigger Accomplice with no color tie.

members.name: Misers
members.why: Holding white against cashing it in is a real tension.

members.name: Money Changers
members.why: Paid by every follower buy at the table; cheap 2-count, passive.

members.name: Hoarder
members.why: Sets up a Cash In or Misers payoff; solitary.

members.name: Doppelganger
members.why: Copy your best member; doubles the leader's engine.

members.name: Deprogrammers
members.why: A follower sting on every swap or steal; cheap for worth 4.

members.name: Hostesses
members.why: Steady gift engine that feeds rivals' contest automatically; no aim.

members.name: Smooth Talkers
members.why: Strong flexibility, but 11 cost puts it out of reach of the swaps and favors whoever is already rich.

members.name: Bodyguards
members.why: Total steal immunity: a block that matters, but it's a wall, not an engine.

members.name: Kidnapper
members.why: Takes a rival's member every round from round I; the victim is robbed repeatedly with no choice.

members.name: Fence
members.why: Punishes stealers with magenta; a counter card, quiet unless a thief is at the table.

members.name: Agents
members.why: A clean block against copiers, cheap; a counter card more than an engine.

members.name: Mob
members.why: Big round-end payout for leading red count; rivals can race red members, but it pays the leader.

members.name: Double Agent
members.why: Swap itself for a rival's better member; a sting, though the rival gets a body back.

members.name: Gardeners
members.why: Fills empty colors each round, helping sets and the player who lacks; nobody else notices.

members.name: Big Tent
members.why: Rewards one of each color; a real shape choice for your cult.

members.name: Patroness
members.why: Followers whenever shop cards are buried links Blue's spaces; unclear whether the round reset counts.

members.name: Loyalists
members.why: Swap immunity for your cult; a counter card the table must route around.

members.name: Early Birds
members.why: Cheap immunity to skips; a clean counter card.

members.name: Gossip
members.why: Pays on every skip at the table, nice link to Hold Up and Bouncers, but rivals never feel it.

members.name: Debt Collectors
members.why: Pulls gifted silver back once to swing the silver contest; feels more like taking than giving.

members.name: Tourist
members.why: Followers every round for color spread, an engine you can see coming.

members.name: Window Shopper
members.why: Cycles the shop and pays colors; fine shop control.

members.name: Trendsetters
members.why: Each recruit churns the shop; feeds Patroness and Scavenger.

members.name: Cutpurse
members.why: Cheap steady drain on the richest rival; good check on hoards, autopilot.

members.name: Accomplice
members.why: A cheap one-shot steal of 3; clear and fine.

members.name: Shoplifter
members.why: A steal on every recruit; steady and on theme.

members.name: Cashier
members.why: A Cash In on a card; timing choice, but repeats the space.

members.name: Wallflower
members.why: Doubling copied gains builds a real copy engine, but only for the rich and at 10 cost.

members.name: Night Owls
members.why: A permanent extra minion from round II is a strong, readable purple rule bend.

members.name: Hot Streak
members.why: A one-shot payoff for chaining turns builds toward a moment, though counting turns just before needs care.

members.name: Meddler
members.why: Swapping each rival's resources hits contests table-wide, but 'one for one' into what color needs asking.

members.name: Shopaholics
members.why: Permanent double buys is a big engine that runs away for the richest player.

members.name: Doormen
members.why: A forced trade of a rival's member through the shop; strong but reads like red and needs care.

members.name: Raiders
members.why: A one-shot follower steal that pays the victim; reads magenta.

members.name: Impersonator
members.why: Steals a rival's ability each round; strong, but the table has to remember which.

members.name: Courier
members.why: Turns double turns into a color spread; combos with Right Away, Crunch Time and snake ends.

members.name: Closer
members.why: Ties straight into the went-last contest and token play; a race rivals can see.

members.name: Drifters
members.why: A chosen-color member plays off New Blood, Big Tent and member-count contests; needs a marker for the color.

members.name: Mentor & Protégés
members.why: Two members for one recruit is a real red burst and feeds Proselytizers and Recruiter.

members.name: Panel
members.why: A built-in Promote or Demote on arrival; on theme and aimable.

members.name: Desperado
members.why: Steals grow while you trail: a clear catch-up card.

members.name: Old Maid
members.why: A poison card to dump on rivals with Godparent, Promote or Double Agent; a table laugh.

members.name: Anarchist
members.why: Swap any two members anywhere each round: real table-wide aim, though rivals lose cards to it repeatedly.

members.name: Spoilsport
members.why: Cancel a contest you can't win; a clear spite card the leader can see coming.

members.name: Sore Loser
members.why: Takes followers from the top contest winner if you win none; catch-up, tie case unstated.

members.name: Hawker
members.why: Rivals choose to overpay you or let you take it free: both sides weigh, but the text is long.

members.name: Fan Club
members.why: Copies a space the leader holds: aims at the front-runner.

members.name: Stunt Double
members.why: Doubles the space you just took, any color; a timing choice.

members.name: Body Snatchers
members.why: A swap every round start gives Red a recurring threat that Loyalists and Deprogrammers play off; equal cost keeps it fair.

members.name: Bouncers
members.why: A double skip on recruit is a felt table moment with timing choice; meets Gossip and Early Birds.

members.name: Godparent
members.why: Cash out a member as a gift; combos with Old Maid, Martyrs and rival dumping.

members.name: Debutantes
members.why: Double your silver once is a big, timed contest swing; the gift to rivals is a nice tax.

members.name: Recluse
members.why: Pays the small cult, a real counter-plan to member-heavy rivals.

members.name: Tribute Band
members.why: Doing a rival's whole round is a huge moment, but at 14 cost it's slow and can't be swapped back.

members.name: Party Crasher
members.why: Joining a taken space breaks blocking once; aimable catch-up.

members.name: Creditor
members.why: Aim it at the leader each round; they lose followers but gain silver, so it stings fairly and helps you catch up.

members.name: Martyrs
members.why: Taking it from you pays you; deters thieves and swaps and combos with Farewell.

members.name: Second-Story Man
members.why: A steal timed right before contests swings any rim; rivals see it coming.

spaces.name: Stash
spaces.why: Same shape as Gather and Allowance; no theft angle at all.

spaces.name: Allowance
spaces.why: Same text as Gather and Stash; the white tie is only the followers.

spaces.name: Build Up
spaces.why: Green's plain anchor.

spaces.name: Gather
spaces.why: The Gather/Stash/Allowance shape; a recruit nudge.

spaces.name: Sweet Talk
spaces.why: Silver plus free conversion; a fuel space with a twist nobody sees.

spaces.name: Polish
spaces.why: A clean conversion that nobody else notices; overlaps Sweet Talk and Polisher.

spaces.name: Shake Down
spaces.why: The victim picks their own punishment, which feels bad to be hit by.

spaces.name: Exchange
spaces.why: Straight resource-to-follower conversion; works, but nobody else cares.

spaces.name: Harvest
spaces.why: Plain fuel in your colors; the yellow anchor.

spaces.name: Estate Sale
spaces.why: A weaker twin of Farewell.

spaces.name: Demote
spaces.why: Same swap as Promote but downward; useful for red count and Deprogrammers, less of a moment.

spaces.name: Potluck
spaces.why: Rivals pay you a resource and get silver back; mild trade, rivals choose the cheapest.

spaces.name: Splurge
spaces.why: Turns a big buy into followers; round III rate unstated.

spaces.name: Walk-In
spaces.why: Blind recruit from the pile with a gift to rivals; the allowed gamble.

spaces.name: Peek
spaces.why: Pile control and good blue; the reorder sets up later shops, but text has two parts to read.

spaces.name: Melting Pot
spaces.why: Pays for a broad cult; clean, but solitary.

spaces.name: Right Away
spaces.why: Double turn for tempo with small purple; clean and timing-driven.

spaces.name: Leaders' Tax
spaces.why: Reads where rivals went and taxes the busy color: a neat board read.

spaces.name: Big New Blood
spaces.why: A bigger New Blood one ring up; repeats the round I space.

spaces.name: Bury
spaces.why: Denial plus blue; the half-cost math adds a step.

spaces.name: Cover
spaces.why: Copy an empty space; flexible, solitary.

spaces.name: Tryout
spaces.why: Borrowing any shop member's On Recruit is a clean idea with real aim, though it plays more like a copy than a recruit.

spaces.name: New Blood
spaces.why: Rewards a first member of a new color; good aim but nobody else feels it.

spaces.name: Savings
spaces.why: Blue plus a bury to deny a rival's target; quiet but real.

spaces.name: Cash In
spaces.why: All white to followers in round III; a satisfying finish, solitary.

spaces.name: Reprise
spaces.why: Doubles your own best space; solitary.

spaces.name: Initiation
spaces.why: A free member up to 8 is a strong, readable round III finisher; the choice is mostly just the best card.

spaces.name: Last Call
spaces.why: Pays more the more minions you hold back, a real gamble on spaces staying open; token rules need a read.

spaces.name: Overtime
spaces.why: +1 minion in round III is plain and strong.

spaces.name: Toast
spaces.why: Big scaling silver with a gift to every rival that feeds their contest; simple and on theme.

spaces.name: Sample
spaces.why: Borrows a rival's best On Recruit; strong cross-color reach, needs a look at rival cards.

spaces.name: Sleep In
spaces.why: Big purple for giving up tempo, and the Goes Last token links the contest, Last Call and Night Watch.

spaces.name: Hold Up
spaces.why: A skip the victim can see coming and shrug off; 'even yours' adds a real timing choice.

spaces.name: Crunch Time
spaces.why: Three turns in a row is a rule bend you feel; you pick the moment to grab key spaces.

spaces.name: Makeover
spaces.why: Rearranging your pile in round III sets up contests and full sets in one move.

spaces.name: Recruit Twice
spaces.why: Two buys in one turn is the clean blue rule bend.

spaces.name: Spree
spaces.why: Three buys in round III; a big finish for a stocked player.

spaces.name: Lie Low
spaces.why: Small steal plus a round of safety: a visible block the table plays around.

spaces.name: Greatest Hits
spaces.why: Round III payoff for a cult of On Recruit members; a visible engine finish.

spaces.name: Promote
spaces.why: Trading up into a rival's better member is a big, aimable swing that hits the leader, though the two-step text needs a read.

spaces.name: Help Yourself
spaces.why: The clean core steal; aim and split are real choices and the victims shrug.

spaces.name: Heist
spaces.why: Three followers straight off a rival; aimable catch-up.

spaces.name: Farewell
spaces.why: Cash a member for its cost in followers; plays off Martyrs and the shop.

spaces.name: Out of Style
spaces.why: Wipe a color from the shop: denies a rival's plan and pays you per card.

spaces.name: Poach
spaces.why: Take any rival member free in round III: a big aimed swing, late enough to be fair.

spaces.name: Party Gifts
spaces.why: Aimed gifts that buy followers but feed rivals' silver contest: the color's core tension in one line.

spaces.name: Largesse
spaces.why: Up to 10 silver to rivals in round III right before a 10-follower silver contest: a real who-do-I-crown choice.

spaces.name: Echo
spaces.why: Copies whatever the last player did, so every turn becomes a read of the table.
